messages:
tess_pm: OptiMetrics wants a combined 'feature economics + SLO' pane in Console for their execs. They need: cost per feature, error spikes tied to deploys, and ability to export a one-page report. Can we scope MVP?

ronin_eng: Minimal backend changes: accept an optional feature_tag on requests; capture tokens_in/out and model_id; emit an error_flag. No full payload sampling initially.

maya_ui: UI MVP: single selector for feature, short time window presets (14/30/90d), stacked bar for cost components, and an error/latency mini-timeline with clickable spikes. Export as PDF/CSV.

sylvia_sre: Operational constraints: feature_tag must be opt-in per-org. We'll enforce sampling quotas for any trace fetches. Add guard: if telemetry ingestion rate increases >5% after rollout, auto-rollback.

telemetry-bot: Flag created: feature_econ_slo_beta. Runbook placeholder added.

ronin_eng: Cost calc note: cost_usd = (tokens_in + tokens_out) * price_snapshot_at_ingest. We'll annotate each event with price_id. If price retcon occurs, we document reconciliation rules.

tess_pm: Acceptance criteria suggestion:
- Can pick a feature and see cost/day + error-rate/day for last 30d
- Click an error point -> fetch up to 8 on-demand traces (counts against org quota)
- Generate export with columns: feature, date, tokens_in, tokens_out, model_id, unit_price_usd, cost_usd, errors, p95_ms

maya_ui: UX tip: show a "why cost rose" micro-overlay listing token delta vs model price change vs increased volume. Helps finance narrative.

sylvia_sre: We'll own the alert: "feature_econ_ingest_spike" if ingress CPU or event rate >5% baseline. Notify #eng-oncall.

tess_pm: Timeline: prototype in 2w, beta with OptiMetrics in 6w if they provide feature->route mapping. Full GA depends on perf and legal review for trace retention.
ronin_eng: Action items: I'll add schema change PR for feature_tag and price_id. maya_ui will push mockups. sylvia_sre will draft rollback/alert playbook. tess_pm will request mapping from OptiMetrics.

telemetry-bot: Meeting scheduled: feature-econ-beta review in 1 week.

tess_pm: Thanks team. Closing thread for now.
